versions.message:
Vocabulary update: re-resolved against OMOP vocabulary v5.0 29-AUG-26 (previously v5.0 27-FEB-26).
160 → 159 concepts.

**Removed (1) — made non-standard, now mapping outside the set:**

- Corynebacterium mediolanum (4348157) → Agromyces mediolanus (4138166) — outside the set

**Renamed (4) by the vocabulary:**

- Corynebacterium diphtheriae type gravis → Corynebacterium diphtheriae biotype gravis (4306916)
- Corynebacterium diphtheriae type intermedius → Corynebacterium diphtheriae biotype intermedius (4321988)
- Corynebacterium diphtheriae type mitis → Corynebacterium diphtheriae biotype mitis (4028997)
- Corynebacterium diphtheriae var belfanti → Corynebacterium diphtheriae biotype belfanti (4352617)
